questions: What is a contract?
If a contract is broken, must one side pay?
What is a commit?
Can a commit be undone after it is made?
What is an issue?
If an issue is closed, is it gone for good?
What is a regression?
If there is a regression, are you back where you started?
What is validation?
If something passes validation, is it guaranteed to be right?
What is a release?
Once a release is out, can it be called back?
What is a merge?
If a merge goes wrong, can it be separated again?
What is a deadlock?
When a deadlock is broken, does everyone get to move?
What is a leak?
When a leak stops, is everything back to normal?
What is a build?
If a build fails, is there nothing usable?
What is inheritance?
If an inheritance changes, do all the children get the same thing?
What is an exception?
If an exception is handled, does the normal path continue?
What is a branch?
If a branch is cut off, does the rest keep growing?
What is binding?
If a binding is removed, is nothing tied anymore?
What is an overload?
If an overload is removed, do the remaining calls become easier to handle?
